Use: real workflow regression, cross-tenant access, hand-checked quantities/score

1. Read current manifests plus package-lock.json and apps/api/uv.lock; record actual
   installed versions and current commit in docs/dependency-source-register.md.
2. Prefer installed compatible packages; consult docs/source at matching release tag.
3. For a justified addition, choose a supported version compatible with the runtime/
   adapter, record exact version/licence/upstream tag and update existing lockfiles.
4. For model/assets/data, record exact digest/version/source/rights and hardware needs.
5. Record feature -> repository module -> dependency -> source doc -> acceptance test.
6. Report 'not verified' when a version/path has not been inspected. Never label a
   moving main branch or latest docs URL as a frozen reproducible dependency pin.

Suggested locations are architectural responsibilities, NOT verified existing files:
apps/api/app/domain/briefs/ - scope acknowledgements and unresolved assumptions.
apps/api/app/domain/quantities/ - method/units, plant/material schedule derivation.
apps/api/app/domain/change_control/ - impact ledger and proposal revisions.
apps/api/app/domain/comparison/ - reviewed scope mappings and readiness rules.
apps/web/src/features/studio/ - plant/material/source/readiness panels.
apps/web/src/features/organisation/ - intake, comparison, rubric and signoff.
Reuse current modules and conventions where they already implement these duties.
